agent_events_description: Raise an alert when Windows logs a matching event. The agent gets the rules with its next report.
agent_events_empty: No rule yet: Windows events raise no alert. Start from an example or add your own.
agent_events_err_load: Could not load the event log rules
agent_events_form_channel_help: System, Application, Security, or a channel such as Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational.
agent_events_form_ids_help: Comma-separated, ranges allowed: 4625, 7000-7099. Empty for any ID.
agent_events_form_pattern_help: Case-insensitive text. Leave empty to keep every matching event.
agent_events_form_provider_help: Provider name as shown in Event Viewer, such as Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power. Empty for any source.
agent_events_form_severity_help: The alert raised on this machine for each matching event.
agent_events_limit_hint: At most {count} events per rule and per minute are sent; the rest is counted as skipped.
agent_events_unsupported: This machine does not run Windows: its agent has no event log to read, these rules are not sent.
